Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

videos.caption: This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. This one is next level tasty 🤤   a top-notch heavy appetizer, perfect to bring to a party or to serve at your next gathering.  alll ingredients are from @ALDI USA 🧡 #summerrecipes #tomatoes #burrata #EasyRecipes #healthyrecipes #healthylifestyle #burratafilling #roastedtomatoes #easyappetizer #cheesydip #garlicbread #tomatoburratadip #tiktokfoodie #viralrecipe #cheesepull #easyrecipes #summerappetizer #dinnerpartyideas #homemadegoodness #heavyappetizers, #foodtutorials, #gourmetfood, #partyfood, #appetizers, #fingerfood, #recipeideas,  #appetizer, #foodtutorial, #partyfood, #gourmet #creatorsearchinsights #carlyscookbook  #alditiktok #aldi

crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

POV: your dinner is watching you👁️👁️👻😂🤭 Save this recipe for Halloween🎃 Spooky Eyeball Stuffed Shells Ingredients: For the filling: • Vegan ground beef - 12 oz (340 g) • 1 Bell pepper, finely diced • 1 Onion, finely diced • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Tomato paste - 1 tbsp • Tomato sauce - 1/3 cup (80 ml) • Smoked paprika - to taste • Italian seasoning - to taste • Olive oil - 1 tbsp • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the tomato sauce: • Strained tomatoes - 26.5 oz (750 g) • Agave syrup - 1 tsp • Italian seasoning - 1 tsp • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the stuffed shells: • 18 Jumbo pasta shells • 9 Mini vegan mozzarella balls, halved • Black olives - as needed, sliced • Tomato paste - as needed, for the veins • Fresh thyme - optional How to make: 1. Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. Stir 1/3 cup (80 ml) of the tomato sauce into the filling. 5. Cook the jumbo shells according to package directions until al dente. Drain and let cool just enough to handle. 6. Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Stuff each shell generously with the filling and arrange in the dish. 7. Spoon a little tomato sauce over each shell. 8. Top each shell with half of a mini vegan mozzarella ball and a slice of black olive to create the pupil. Use a small amount of tomato paste to draw thin red veins over the mozzarella, then add a little fresh thyme if desired. 9. Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 15 minutes. hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Transfer to a floured surface and knead/fold it 4–5 times. Cover and let it rise another 30 minutes. Place your Dutch oven in the oven and preheat to 450°F. Carefully remove the hot Dutch oven, place the dough on parchment paper and put it inside.
